The short grievance of the Petitioners in this Writ Petition is that though the Respondents have acquired the land admeasuring 6700 sq. mtrs. owned by the Petitioners, the Competent Authority has paid the compensation amount only in the Sukhdeo Sidha Markad And Ors vs Union Of India Thr Ministry Of Road ... on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16761215/
1 sum of Rs.82,51,600/- and have refused to pay the amount of Rs.1,14,93,300/- to the Petitioners.

sentences.text: The case of the National Highway is that upon taking measurement, it is found that the area acquired is less than the area of 6700 sq. mtrs.

Learned advocate for the National Highway does not dispute that in all notifications issued under the provisions of National Highways Act, 1956 and in the award the area of acquisition is mentioned as 6700 sq. mtrs.
3.

In our prima-facie view, the area under acquisition is 6700 sq. mtrs. and thus we direct the National Highway Authority to deposit the amount of Rs.1,14,93,300/- for the time being in this Court within one week from today without fail with intimation to the learned advocate for the Petitioners.
The Respondent - National Highway to file affidavit in reply within one week from today and shall serve a copy thereof upon the Petitioner's advocate simultaneously.
4. Place the matter High on Board on 27 April, 2023.

(GAURI GODSE, J.) (R.D. DHANUKA, J.)
